headline: Nevish Line Still Contested; Colonials Gain at Linn Mercy
war_summary: Action on the Nevish Line has eased from the furious pace of the prior edition but has not stopped: the sector now reads five Warden works against three Colonial, a Colonial gain, and it logged six actions in two hours about Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother and Princefal, with some 6,197 Colonial and 7,147 Warden casualties over the day. Marban Hollow has lost a Warden work to no-man's-land and now stands three works apiece with two unclaimed, its latest action falling at this edition's cutoff. Linn Mercy has shifted to nine Colonial works and one Warden, fighting at Lathair having continued into the small hours. Weathered Expanse holds at six Warden, one Colonial and two unclaimed, but its guns have cooled sharply, three actions in two hours against fifty-one in a day, and its hourly casualty rates have fallen from the hundreds to a comparative handful around Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance. Kuura Strand has gone silent since the previous evening, leaving five Colonial works and one unclaimed. Heavy bloodshed without a change of colours continues in the Dead Lands, Callahan's Passage, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle.
